name: Shrouded in Nightmare
label: Quest
description: Shrouded in Nightmare: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There may be a link between this object and the dragons coming forth from the Dream. You must find someone that can decipher the meaning of this item. Perhaps the druids of the Moonglade or Cenarion Hold could assist you further.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I must remove the taint from this object. This may shed some light on my recent failures to delve into the Dream. Give it to me.
